q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
(a) **Time left until resolution:**
NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release has already occurred (the guidance was issued on May 20, 2026, and today is August 15, 2026). The actual Q2 FY2027 results should have been announced by now. This is asking for what NVIDIA guided for Q2 FY2027, which was already provided in the research.

(b) **Most likely outcome and why:**
According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**. This means the guidance range is $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion (±2% around $91.0B).

The research explicitly states: "NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, as part of its Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%."

This guidance was provided directly by NVIDIA's management and represents their formal forward guidance.

(c) **What would push the value lower:**
- Weaker than expected demand for GPUs
- Accelerated China restrictions limiting revenue opportunities
- Macroeconomic slowdown affecting cloud spending
- Competitive pressure from AMD or other manufacturers
- Supply chain disruptions

(d) **What would push the value higher:**
- Stronger demand for AI compute infrastructure
- Better than expected adoption of NVIDIA's latest generation products
- Expanded enterprise deployments
- Limited competitive threat materializing
- Data center growth accelerating beyond expectations

(e) **Base rate or historical reference values:**
The actual guidance figure is already provided in the research: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. No need to estimate around priors since NVIDIA has already publicly issued this guidance.

**Analysis:**
The question asks for NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue. The research explicitly provides this figure: $91.0 billion with a ±2% band. This is not a prediction of what will happen, but rather a statement of what NVIDIA already guided. The guidance range is $89.18B to $92.82B.

Since the research clearly states the company "expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%," the most likely point estimate is $91.0 billion, with realistic outcomes falling within the official guidance band.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, as part of its Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA also projected GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins to be 74.9% and 75.0%, respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This revenue guidance is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).
